$comment: The one place that says which atomic level each component is and what it is made of. Read by the component build (which checks that imports only go downwards), the stories (titles) and the docs site (index, pages, llms.txt). Wording follows the Figma Components index. Levels are the atomic levels; groups sit beside them (layout helpers are a group, not a level).

levels.name: Atom
levels.rule: Uses no other component. Built from tokens only.

levels.name: Molecule
levels.rule: A few atoms working as one unit.

levels.name: Organism
levels.rule: A self-contained section of a page, built from molecules and atoms.

above: Templates (a page layout with no real content) and pages (a template with real content) are the two levels above. They belong to each product, not to this system.

AccentBar.title: Accent bar
AccentBar.summary: A short orange bar that opens a major section.

Card.title: Card
Card.summary: A raised surface for a note, aside or summary.

Thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
Thumbnail.summary: An image that links to a piece of work.

ThumbnailRow.title: Thumbnail row
ThumbnailRow.summary: One item in a list of work: thumbnail, title, summary.

ThumbnailList.title: Thumbnail list
ThumbnailList.summary: A short list of pieces of work to open.

Container.title: Container
Container.summary: Holds a page's content at the system's width and keeps it off the screen edge.

Stack.title: Stack
Stack.summary: Things in a column with one gap between them.

Cluster.title: Cluster
Cluster.summary: Things in a row that wrap when they run out of room.

Grid.title: Grid
Grid.summary: The system's columns; children say how many they span.

Section.title: Section
Section.summary: The accent bar, a heading, then content, with fixed spacing and the section gap above.

groups.name: Layout helper
groups.rule: Helpers that place things. No look of their own; space comes from the parent's gap; only the named steps. Not a level: they hold components of any level, and may themselves use only atoms and other helpers.
